# World Nuclear Association: Nuclear Power in China

Updated: 17 Aug 2026.

## Key Data
- **64 operable reactors** (63,985 MWe)
- **37 reactors under construction** (38,578 MWe)
- **0 reactors shutdown**

## Electricity Sector (2023)
- Total generation: **9,548 TWh**
- Mix: coal 5,857 TWh (61%); hydro 1,286 TWh (13%); wind 886 TWh (9%); solar 584 TWh (6%); **nuclear 435 TWh (5%)**; natural gas 283 TWh (3%); biofuels & waste 206 TWh (2%).
- Import/export: 17.1 TWh net export.
- Total consumption: 8,013 TWh. Per capita: ~5,700 kWh (2023).

## Policy Context
- Impetus: air pollution from coal, climate commitments, energy security.
- China's policy: **closed nuclear fuel cycle**.
- Largely self-sufficient in reactor design/construction; adapting Western technology.
- Major strength: **nuclear supply chain**.
- Policy to "go global" with exporting nuclear technology.
- 2014: Premier announced ~20% of primary energy from non-fossil fuels by 2030.
- Sep 2020: Premier stated intent to reach peak CO2 emissions before 2030.
